synthetic_data_notice: All variables, states, and CPT values in this file describe a fictional, synthetic educational simulation modelled on the context of FIT HANU (Khoa Công nghệ Thông tin, Trường Đại học Hà Nội). This is NOT a real student-evaluation system and must never be used to assess any actual student.
context: Simulates a synthetic FIT HANU IT student's academic trajectory in a semester. All variable names, states, and CPT values are chosen for pedagogical clarity in a CS50 AI course on Bayesian Networks — not as a real performance prediction model.

nodes.name: PriorPreparation
nodes.description: Synthetic measure of how prepared the FIT HANU student was before the semester started (e.g. foundation course grades, self-study during summer).

nodes.name: Attendance
nodes.description: Synthetic class-attendance level at FIT HANU lecture and lab sessions during the semester. A student with High attendance rarely misses AIN301 or lab sessions in Nhà C.

nodes.name: ExamDifficulty
nodes.description: Synthetic exam difficulty, an external factor independent of the student. Represents how challenging the AIN301 midterm or final paper happens to be that semester.

nodes.name: StudyConsistency
nodes.description: How consistently the synthetic FIT HANU student studied throughout the semester, driven by prior preparation and attendance habits.

nodes.name: AssignmentCompletion
nodes.description: Fraction of assignments and project milestones completed on time, driven by study consistency. In AIN301 this includes the Midterm AI Core submission and Final AI Product.

nodes.name: Performance
nodes.description: Synthetic final academic outcome for the semester, driven by assignment completion and exam difficulty. Modelled on a 3-tier grading band used for illustration.

independence_notes: PriorPreparation and Attendance have no parents and are modeled as marginally independent root causes.
ExamDifficulty has no parents and is independent of every student-side variable; it is an external root cause set by the instructor.
AssignmentCompletion is conditionally independent of PriorPreparation and Attendance given StudyConsistency.
Performance is conditionally independent of PriorPreparation, Attendance, and StudyConsistency given AssignmentCompletion and ExamDifficulty.
